description: Package-owned ram_copies for issuer/audience/widget/jti to verified page/user/iat/exp bindings, user revocation cutoffs, cluster reset cutoff, and idempotent control nonce results. Transactional claim/revocation race handling, majority protection, explicit cluster membership, fail-closed unavailable/minority behavior, bounded expiry cleanup, rolling restart preservation, full RAM reset rejection. Add focused real peer-node tests.

comments.text: Implemented package-owned Mnesia ram_copies with configured replica membership, quorum and majority checks, transactional first-page claim/reconnect, revocation cutoffs, idempotent control requests, reset cutoff and bounded cleanup. Single-node tests plus real three-node peer script cover replay, concurrent claims, rolling restart, revocation race, minority failure and full RAM reset. Store is not wired into JWT verification until ww-v4a.3; process-local ReplayGuard remains temporarily for existing behavior.

title: Implement replicated Mnesia token bindings and revocation cutoffs
